data/ark-holdings.json.notes: ARK Invest's daily ETF holdings via arkfunds.io community API. Day-over-day diff against prior snapshot reveals NEW POSITIONS, ADDS, TRIMS, and CLOSED POSITIONS. 1%+ share-count change threshold filters routine rebalancing. Cross-fund aggregation highlights multi-fund conviction (strongest ARK signal). Migrated from direct CSV downloads (broken 2025) to arkfunds.io in ops 1062.

data/stablecoin-flow.json.state_description: Net stablecoin contraction -- USD liquidity exiting crypto. Historically precedes drawdowns of 15-30% in BTC over 60-90 days. Deleveraging regime.

data/firm-book.json.headline: Firm book: 100 net equity names, 40% gross / -3% net (18% long vs 21% short), top-10 = 30% of gross. 0 cross-desk conviction overlaps, 0 desk conflicts. Macro sleeve 0 positions, +0% net.
data/firm-book.json.disclaimer: Model book implied by the strategy desks at the allocator's capital weights -- not the user's actual portfolio and not investment advice.

data/paper-book.json.thesis: Systematic paper book — trades the system's read (buy booming sleeves, avoid destroyed, regime-tilt), realistic slippage, marked to market daily vs SPY. Research → honest track record.
data/paper-book.json.note: Paper capital $100k, long-only, no leverage, 25% single-name cap, 5bps slippage, weekly + regime-change rebalance. Track record builds from inception — treat early stats as preliminary.
